script_reviews.summary: Script is scientifically sound overall, age-appropriate for Class 7, and has a conversational teacher-like tone. All three learning objectives are covered: plants make their own food, raw materials are identified, and products are stated. The main improvement needed is to make the final word equation explicit and slightly refine a few phrases to avoid possible confusion.

issues.problem: The word equation is implied but not clearly written or spoken as an equation. The learning objective specifically asks to state/write the word equation.
issues.fix: Say or show it explicitly: “कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड + पानी — सूर्य का प्रकाश और क्लोरोफिल की उपस्थिति में → ग्लूकोज़ + ऑक्सीजन।”

issues.problem: “पत्ती के रंध्र हवा से कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड” is elliptical; the verb is missing. Also, some Class 7 students may need a quick reminder of what ‘रंध्र’ means.
issues.fix: Revise to: “पत्तियों के छोटे-छोटे छिद्र, जिन्हें रंध्र कहते हैं, हवा से कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड अंदर लेते हैं।”

issues.problem: “पत्ती का हरा रंग, क्लोरोफिल” is a simplification; chlorophyll is the green pigment present in leaves, not just the colour itself.
issues.fix: Revise to: “पत्तियों में मौजूद हरा पदार्थ, क्लोरोफिल, सूरज की रोशनी की ऊर्जा पकड़ता है।”
